statement: Create src/lib/scan/arrival-card.ts, a pure module with no React, DOM, fetch or database imports, exporting arrivalRecommendation(input) where input is { pendingOrdersForCarton: number, rackHasSpace: boolean, expectedCartons: number, arrivedCartons: number } and the result is { action: 'unbox_now' | 'rack', reason: string, secondary: 'rack' | 'unbox_now' }: unbox_now when pendingOrdersForCarton >= 1 with reason like '3 orders are waiting on this carton', otherwise rack when rackHasSpace with reason 'Nothing is waiting on it — rack it for later', and unbox_now with reason 'Rack is full' when nothing waits but the rack has no space. Also export arrivalTitle({ carrier, tracking }) returning 'Arrival · UPS 4471' using the carrier display name and the last four characters of the tracking string, and arrivalFacts({ seller, expectedCartons, arrivedCartons }) returning at most three short strings. Write src/lib/scan/arrival-card.test.ts with node:test covering all three recommendation branches, the title, and facts capped at three. Touch no other file.
routerHint: pure arrival recommendation unbox now rack it reason title carrier last4 facts node:test
